name: How do you assess the extent of damage for a deck structural repair?

mainEntity.name: How do you assess the extent of damage for a deck structural repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our assessment begins with a thorough inspection of the entire deck structure, including footings, posts, beams, joists, and connections, to identify all areas of compromise. We look for signs of rot, insect damage, corrosion, and improper construction techniques. This detailed evaluation helps us understand the full scope of necessary repairs, allowing us to provide an accurate and comprehensive repair plan tailored to your deck's specific issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: We conduct a thorough inspection of all deck components to identify rot, damage, and improper construction, informing the repair plan.
